summary: Echoes on Other Worlds is a NASA Space Apps Challenge project about the space hardware left behind on the Moon and Mars. It highlights Apollo 11, ALSEP, Sojourner, Spirit, and Opportunity, showing how their missions and discoveries continue to contribute to space exploration even after the missions end.
details: Echoes on Other Worlds is a storytelling project that explores the space equipment and machines left behind on the Moon and Mars after NASA missions. It works by collecting information about past space missions and explaining their purposes, discoveries, and contributions through simple stories and illustrations. This project helps students learn about space exploration, understand scientific discoveries, preserve the history of space missions, and inspire young people to explore science and technology.
